title: Random forest risk model for pertussis in children
summary: A random forest built on features chosen by lasso regression and the Boruta algorithm, from 1085 suspected pertussis patients at 7 centers, reached validation AUC 0.98 and external validation AUC 0.97. The study is retrospective and the numbers are from the abstract-level evidence reviewed.
ai_technology: Random forest with lasso and Boruta feature selection

evidence.tested: Validation and external datasets from multiple centers.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance; details of the external datasets.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts pertussis risk from routine features

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
